Core indicator create/dedupe and binding insert/reuse commit atomically; `duplicate` appears only in the link result; new and reused bindings return HTTP 201 and 200 respectively.
Every safe digest resource or audit field carries its key ID, and key rotation preserves comparison only within equal key IDs.
